intro: Furl Scornbrow is an aging orc lookout stationed in the watchtower northwest of Razor Hill. No longer able to fight on the front lines due to his advancing years, he keeps watch over the red canyons of Durotar and crafts sturdy packs for young travelers setting out across the land.

p: Perched high in the wooden watchtower just northwest of Razor Hill, Furl Scornbrow keeps a quiet vigil over the central plains of Durotar. In the tense early days following the founding of Orgrimmar, sentries like Furl were vital for sounding signal horns against hostile quilboar, centaur, and Kul Tiras interlopers. As Durotar has stabilized and Razor Hill has established firmer borders, emergencies have grown rarer, leaving Furl plenty of quiet hours at his post.

Furl freely admits that his old bones and fading strength render him useless in battle, but an orc does not easily surrender their purpose. Rather than sitting idle, he puts his hands to work fashioning canvas sacks and packs for fresh recruits who need to carry their supplies. In exchange for coarse thread and practical materials, he equips green adventurers venturing out to prove their worth to the Horde.
